title: Stage query list
statement: Let $N$ be a sequence of finite Boolean oracle machines, let $i$ be a natural number, and let $d$ be stage data with finite set $P$ and bound $b$. The stage query list is the list of queries made by machine $N(i)$, using the oracle consisting of $P$, on the all-true Boolean input of length $L$, within $L^i+i$ steps, where $L$ is the fresh length chosen for $i$ and $b$.
hypotheses_covered: sequence $N$ of finite Boolean oracle machines
caveat: The supplied snippet omits the definitions of the query-running convention and the fresh-length witness property.
